title: ‘Fraggle Rock’ Wraps Up ‘A Holiday Gift’ With Festive Musical Special Featuring Nicole Scherzinger: Watch the Trailer
summary: Fraggle Rock: A Holiday Gift, including original songs from executive music producer Harvey Mason jr., premieres Dec. 4 on Apple TV.
contentText:
The Fraggles are back with a festive new musical holiday special, and they’re bringing a Tony winner along for the sleigh ride.

Fraggle Rock: A Holiday Gift , which premieres globally Dec. 4 on Apple TV, includes Tony nominee Lilli Cooper returning as Doc and Tony winner Nicole Scherzinger performing a snow-covered musical number — and Billboard Family is exclusively premiering the trailer below.

In the new special (which follows last year’s The First Snow of Fraggle Rock ), Wembley is named Spirit Captain and is in charge of spreading holiday cheer throughout Fraggle Rock, but the spirit begins to fade when the Fraggles unknowingly take a snow globe from Doc’s workshop. How will they fix the mistletoe mishap? You’ll just have to tune in next month to find out.

Watch the full trailer below:

This will mark Scherzinger’s first Fraggle Rock appearance and it comes the year after she took home best actress in a musical at the 2025 Tony Awards for her performance in the revival of Andrew Lloyd Webber’s Sunset Boulevard — a role she originated on London’s West End and earned her an Olivier Award as well. Scherzinger also reunited with two of her Pussycat Dolls bandmates earlier this year for the PCD Forever Tour, which kicked off in June and wrapped up last month with shows across Europe and Brazil.

The Jim Henson Company’s Fraggle Rock: A Holiday Gift is executive produced by Lisa Henson, Halle Stanford, John Tartaglia, Matt Fusfeld, Alex Cuthbertson, Arnon Milchan and Yariv Milchan, with co-executive producers Dave Goelz and Karen Prell as well as Recording Academy CEO Harvey Mason jr. as executive music producer. The special was written by Fusfeld and Cuthbertson, produced by Chris Plourde, co-produced by Tim O’Brien, and directed by Tartaglia.
